lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The white circular blobs are arranged in approximately eight visible vertical columns, with each column containing 3 to 5 high-luminance maxima forming a structured grid posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical linear features of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots at 90-degree angles, creating a distinct checkerboard-like coordinate system.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible, defined by a sharp luminance transition from a high-intensity upper edge to a low-intensity shadow region directly below the ridge crest.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A minimum of five high-luminance spots are distributed across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin, predominantly clustered near the mid-section and base.

other_distinctive_markers: A large remora (Echeneidae) is attached to the dorsal-anterior surface of the shark, and a cluster of smaller teleost fish is visible in the water column below the pectoral fin.
